chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who falls asleep while he is in sajdah. He said: "He should leave and perform wudu (ablution)."

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.سَاجِدٌ: being in the state of sajdah (prostration)
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفُ: he should leave or discontinue from his current state

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he falls asleep while in sajdah during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on sleep occurring during sajdah in salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that the person should discontinue and perform wudu (ablution), indicating that such sleep is treated as requiring ritual purification.
